definitions.explanation: The ability to understand something without conscious reasoning.
A natural sense or perception beyond the five senses.

examples.japanese: {長年|ながねん}の{経験|けいけん}で{勘|かん}が{鋭|するど}くなった。
examples.english: Years of experience sharpened my intuition.

examples.japanese: {何|なに}か{変|へん}だと{勘|かん}が{働|はたら}いた。
examples.english: My gut told me something was off.

examples.japanese: {勘|かん}を{頼|たよ}りに{道|みち}を{探|さが}した。
examples.english: I searched for the way relying on my instincts.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{勘|かん}の{鋭|するど}い{人|ひと}で、{嘘|うそ}をつくとすぐに{気|き}づく。
examples.english: She has a keen sixth sense and immediately notices when someone is lying.

notes:
{勘|かん} refers to intuitive understanding.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {勘|かん}がいい: to have good intuition
- {勘|かん}が{悪|わる}い: to have poor intuition
- {勘|かん}が{働|はたら}く: intuition works
- {勘|かん}を{頼|たよ}りに: relying on intuition

COMPOUNDS:
- {勘違|かんちが}い: misunderstanding
- {勘定|かんじょう}: calculation, bill
